acme net balance retrieved. Next fetch net balance for remaining customers birch and cobalt, then record payouts once per customer.

Refunds appear complete for this batch (only orders 213 and 214 refunded; order 211 not refunded per Alpha failure and ledger). Proceed to record one payout per customer for their net balances.
